name: UCR Time Series Classification Archive
description: The UCR Time Series Classification Archive is the gold-standard benchmark repository for time-series classification. Maintained by researchers at UC Riverside and University of East Anglia, it features 128 standardized univariate time-series datasets spanning sensor data, ECG/EEG, motion capture, audio spectrograms, and simulated physics.
